title: AtlasScribe: Map Generator
description: A map plan in, a map out. You decide what matters (the roads, the river, the square, the landmarks, what each district is like) and AtlasScribe fills in the rest procedurally: streets, lots, houses, gardens, trees and clutter, painted from the map art you already have. Settlements and cities first, battle maps later. System agnostic. Early development: not ready for use yet.

recommends.reason: Paints maps with the Forgotten Adventures art you have through FA Nexus. Without it, AtlasScribe uses other art folders or plain fills.
